CITY OF PASADENA
  City Council Minutes
  June 20, 2025-9:00 A.M.
  La Casita Del Arroyo
  177 South Arroyo Boulevard
  Pasadena, CA91105

  SPECIAL MEETING

OPENING:  Mayor Gordo called the special meeting to order at 9:03 a.m.
  (Absent: Councilmember Hampton)

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Victor M. Gordo
  Councilmembers:  Vice Mayor Jessica Rivas
  Councilmember Rick Cole
  CouncilmemberTyron Hampton (Arrived at 9:09 a.m.)
  Councilmember Justin Jones
  Councilmember Jason Lyon
  Councilmember Steve Madison
  Councilmember Gene Masuda

  Staff:  City Manager Miguel Marquez
  City Attorney/City Prosecutor Michele Beal Bagneris
  City Clerk Mark Jomsky

  CITY COUNCIL WORKSHOP MEETING ON ISSUES INCLUDING,
  BUT NOT LIMITED TO, DISCUSSION ON CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING EFFICIENCIES, GROUP DEVELOPMENT AND TEAM
  BUILDING, THE CITY'S BUDGET PROCESS, AND OTHER
  ISSUES AND MATTERS IDENTIFIED BY MEMBERS OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL

Councilmember Hampton  Mayor Gordo introduced Partick Ibarra, the Mejorando Group, as
arrived at 9:09 a.m.  facilitator leading the City Council in their workshop.

  The City Council and City staff participated in a discussion regarding
  the City Council, strategies for creating a more effective governing
  body, meeting efficiencies and protocols, the importance of
  attendance and timeliness in convening City Council and Council
  Committee meetings, including reducing the quorum for Council
  Committees to two Councilmembers to guard against meetings
  being delayed or cancelled, and starting meetings at 5:00 p.m., or
  later, to accommodate working schedules of members of the City
  Council.

Councilmember Hampton left By order of the Mayor, and consensus of the City Council, the
the meeting at 11:51 a.m. meeting was recessed at 11 :51 a.m.

  The City Council meeting was reconvened at 12:27 p.m.

Council Minutes  1  06/20/2025
 Councilmember Madison  The facilitator renewed the discussion regarding City Council
returned at 12:32 p.m.  meeting protocols, with the City Council suggesting that a list of
  meeting guidelines be developed for members of the City Council to
  refer back to during meetings to promote meeting efficiencies. The
  guidelines would be developed by the Legislative Policy Committee,
  submitted to the full City Council for review, and adopted as a policy.
  Additionally, the City Clerk and City Attorney would review adopted
  Councilmember Code of Conduct provisions and incorporate newly
  adopted meeting guidelines as part of the onboarding of new
  Councilmembers.

ADJOURNMENT  Following discussion, on order of the Mayor, and consensus of the
  City Council, the special meeting of the City Council adjourned at
  2:50

  \M
  Victor M. Gordo, Mayo
  City of Pasadena
